<issue>
Throw IAE for odd-length hex strings in Parquet CLI
### Describe the bug, including details regarding any error messages, version, and platform.

`BaseCommand` currently doesn't do any sort of validation and accepts odd-length hex strings, which cause `IndexOutOfBoundsExceptions`.

### Component(s)

CLI

</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

input.instruction: In /testbed, find the Parquet CLI BaseCommand (parquet-cli) and show the code that parses hex strings (e.g. method using Character.digit / hex decoding, likely 'hexToBytes' or similar), with file path and line numbers.

content.content: {"summary":"The hex parser is the private method hexToBytes in parquet-cli's BaseCommand. It strips an optional 0x/0X prefix and converts each pair of characters with Character.digit(..., 16). It does no validation: odd-length input silently drops the last nibble, and invalid characters yield digit -1, corrupting the byte instead of raising an error. It is called for the footer key and for column key IDs.","findings":["parquet-cli/src/main/java/org/apache/parquet/cli/BaseCommand.java:431-443 defines private byte[] hexToBytes(String hex): strips a leading \"0x\"/\"0X\" (433-435), allocates len/2 bytes (437-438), and loops over character pairs (439-441).","parquet-cli/src/main/java/org/apache/parquet/cli/BaseCommand.java:440: data[i / 2] = (byte) ((Character.digit(hex.charAt(i), 16) << 4) + Character.digit(hex.charAt(i + 1), 16)); is the core Character.digit hex decode.","Callers: BaseCommand.java:393 decodes footerKeyHex, inside the decryption-properties builder that returns null when both footerKeyHex and columnKeysHex are null (lines 385-387). BaseCommand.java:421 decodes columnKeyId in parseAndSetColumnKeys (402-429).","No validation: an odd-length string loses its final character, and a non-hex character yields digit -1, which is silently mixed into the byte value. Null input is not handled either (inferred from reading the code; not executed)."],"confidence":0.9}
